subject.title: feat: add per-conversation whatsapp debounce config

question: Should OpenClaw support conversation-specific WhatsApp batching as a WhatsApp-owned `direct`/`groups` configuration field, or first establish the generic plugin debounce-hook contract proposed by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106458?
rationale: Both branches address the same open user need but create different long-lived contracts; code review cannot safely choose the public configuration and plugin-boundary direction without maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor the WhatsApp-owned option
options.body: Keep the policy within the WhatsApp extension, merge this bounded additive configuration surface after live proof, and close or narrow the generic alternative.

options.title: Prefer the generic plugin hook
options.body: Adopt the broader plugin contract only if maintainers want other channel plugins to own comparable per-message debounce policy.

options.title: Defer both surfaces
options.body: Keep the existing channel-level default until a maintainer sets a broader inbound-batching product direction.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the WhatsApp-owned option
recommendation.body: Keep the policy within the WhatsApp extension, merge this bounded additive configuration surface after live proof, and close or narrow the generic alternative.

likelyOwner.reason: Low-confidence adjacent architecture-routing candidate; no current-main ownership history could be established from the provided review material.
